title: Briefe adeliger Frauen (16.-18. Jh.): Beziehungen und Bezugssysteme
institution: Institut für Geschichte, Universität Wien (project funded by the FWF; contact Alexander Sperl)
notes: Letters of Austrian noblewomen from family archives (Schallenberg, Starhemberg and others), with transcriptions and short summaries, plus lists of the wider holdings (about 2,900 letters, 16th-18th century). The letters transcribed on the site are dated 1494 to 1678, none after 1700. The site dates from 1999-2004 (last modified November 2004). The counts cover the letters with period text, and entries with only a modern summary are not included. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence or copyright statement on the home page, project description, source-access pages or Impressum (which only gives a contact, Alexander Sperl, University of Vienna); no data repository. Checked 2026-10-13.
